name: Energy-Preserving CFG (EP-CFG)
plain: Rescales the CFG result to the energy of the positive. The robust default takes energy only from a narrow percentile range.
math:
d = c+(w−1)Δ; x̂ = d·√(E(c)/E(d))
E = sum of squares; robust: only squared entries between percentiles 45 and 55
